tips.text: Buy the Predasite Echo-Lure and call a Medjay in during Vome instead of roaming for a natural spawn.
Add a Predasite Pheromone Gland to the lure to raise the rare subspecies chance.
Hunt only during Vome; Medjay never shows in Fass, where the rare is Pharaoh.
Tranq it, pull a nearby Infested onto the sleeping animal, then go invisible so aggro switches to it before you capture.
Drop a Pherliac Pod on the tranquilized Predasite to pull Infested onto it.
Use Loki's Switch Teleport to move the tranquilized Predasite into a group of Infested.
Hunt on foot with a stealth frame; in Archwing the Infested tend to ignore the target.
Rely on the Tranq Rifle; repeated abilities build resistance until the Predasite is immune.
Donate a spare rank 30 Predasite to Son for Son Tokens; a weakened capture turned into a throwaway pet pays for a gild.
Players count it as worthwhile Mastery; the only complaint is finding a rare Medjay without the lure.
